verdict.rationale: Synctera's Webhook API pushes event notifications to integrators, and the platform supports scheduled payments. Neither is a product-native rule engine that automatically runs actions when events occur. Webhooks are a developer building block for building such automation, and scheduled payments run on a time schedule rather than on event triggers, so neither earns credit for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
